# hyperping_on_call_schedule (Data Source)

Fetches a single Hyperping on-call schedule by ID or name via MCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the schedule.
- `name` (String) The name of the schedule to look up.

### Read-Only

- `current_oncall` (String) The name of the person currently on-call.
- `next_oncall` (String) The name of the person next on-call.
- `rotation_end` (String) End time of the current rotation.
- `rotation_start` (String) Start time of the current rotation.
- `team` (String) The team name this schedule belongs to.
